deliberateDepartures.detail: Used the explicit common light palette instead of the example warm palette. Japanese text stays upright on independent surface sheets; only backing sheets and blank label planes are slightly rotated. Shadows are reduced to 4px and 0.22–0.28 opacity for the small target slots.
Rebuilt the kit’s four-across, two-row filled arch motif with common deep/accent roles. Motif sheets are nonsemantic backing planes, not additional seats, workflow steps or contents.
Exposed lateral motif regions beside broad foreground label sheets to preserve both the long labels and the paper construction.
Used exactly four compact cut chairs on clear backing planes and lower two-line state labels without invented people. The upper-right motif region stays exposed beside each chair.
Dashed waiting branch identifies a result that has not arrived; it is not a failure signal.
